activities.title: Trollers Gill
activities.summary: Trollers Gill is a truly atmospheric place! Find out where to park, where to go and how to keep the kids entertained!
activities.locationLabel: Trollers Gill - Skyreholme, Yorkshire Dales. The beginning of the walk is near Grimwith Reservoir, although there is limited verge side parking at New Road. Do not block farm access to fields or park in passing places.
activities.parking: Lay-by/ verge side Parking is available on the B6265 and on New Road. New Road parking will trim a little length off the route. There is also some limited lay-by parking at Skyreholme which can get muddy. It’s on the road heading in to Parceval Hall, it is limited and by no accounts should you park on the road as this will prevent access for emergency vehicles. When parking have regard for gates and access points to fields. Do not obstruct the road, or any farm access points.
activities.terrainNotes: Rough, easily identifiable paths, the Gill is a rocky riverbed in usual conditions, it floods after heavy rain (see pictures to get an idea of what that looks like!) There is some moderate ascent on this walk and there are some parts that are very muddy.
categories: Family Friendly Walks around the Yorkshire Dales
